topics.text: Located in Moganshan, surrounded by mountains, with good environment, mountain views. Some are on the hillside, and it's convenient to nearby attractions, suitable for self-driving.
There are swimming pools, large room types, floor-to-ceiling windows, new and high-quality decoration, and rich entertainment facilities like playing mahjong, barbecuing, singing.
The boss and staff are enthusiastic, and the service is thoughtful, actively recommending interesting places and delicious food.
The rooms are clean and tidy, with no dust in every corner

address: No. 104, Yujia, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 民宿和圖片完全一致，裝修用心，床品柔軟乾淨，洗漱用品齊全。房東回覆及時，還貼心給了遊玩攻略，位置好找、周邊方便，住得很安心，滿分推薦！
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: Exactly as pictured. The decoration has been thought about, the bedding is soft and clean, and the toiletries are complete. The host replies quickly and sent us a guide to the area. Easy to find, handy for everything, and a stay with nothing to worry about.

comments.quote: 房間很不錯，入住體驗挺好的， 唯一缺點就是實在有點遠+不好找路 地理位置比較偏僻+門口的路況比較顛簸，老闆一家很親切
comments.author: Anonymous User

comments.quote: 看了30多家住宿，最終選擇這家，真的閉眼住行了，太讚了！人好景好吃住玩的好，方方面面360度無死角的舒適！！老闆人品圈重點五顆星好評！！
